item.title: Houthi attack kills two at Saudi airport; US evacuates staff, oil surges amid Iran tensions
item.description: Two people were killed on Wednesday evening in a Houthi attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, eastern Saudi Arabia, Saudi authorities said. The General Authority of Civil Aviation identified the victims as a Saudi citizen and an Indian resident. The Iran-backed Houthis claimed the…

item.title: Russia and Ukraine trade missile and drone strikes after agreeing to resume peace talks
item.description: Russia and Ukraine traded missile and drone strikes overnight, hours after Moscow agreed to resume US-mediated peace talks.
